title: When the Letter Falls
author: Noor Joubert
blurb: Theo Nakamura, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the century turns.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
